faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most single-family re-roofs are done in one to three days depending on size, pitch, layers coming off and the weather. We'll give you a realistic window with the quote rather than an optimistic one.

faqs.q: Will you work with my insurance company?
faqs.a: PLACEHOLDER — confirm how far the client is willing to go on claims support before publishing. Do not imply they negotiate or adjust on the homeowner's behalf unless that is accurate and permitted in their state.

faqs.q: How do I know if I have storm damage?
faqs.a: Hail bruising and wind creasing often are not visible from the ground. Common signs are granules collecting at downspouts, dented soft metals like vents and gutters, and lifted or missing shingles after a storm.

faqs.q: Can you just repair it instead of replacing?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Repair makes sense when the roof has service life left and the damage is localised. We'll tell you which one you're actually looking at, and why.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with the work?
faqs.a: PLACEHOLDER — confirm the manufacturer material warranty and the client's own workmanship warranty before publishing. Do not state a term that has not been verified.
